import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Transaction amount distribution
axes[0, 0].hist(df['amount'], bins=10, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7, color='skyblue')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Amount ($)')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution')
axes[0, 0].axvline(df['amount'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Mean: ${df["amount"].mean():.2f}')
axes[0, 0].legend()

# 2. Transaction types distribution
transaction_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors = ['lightcoral', 'lightgreen', 'lightblue']
axes[0, 1].pie(transaction_counts.values, labels=transaction_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=colors[:len(transaction_counts)], startangle=90)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Transaction Types Distribution')

# 3. Hour of day distribution
hour_counts = df['hour_of_day'].value_counts().sort_index()
axes[0, 2].bar(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, color='lightseagreen', alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Transactions by Hour of Day')
axes[0, 2].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))

# 4. Amount by transaction type
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=axes[1, 0], palette='Set2')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Transaction Amount by Type')

# 5. Amount by hour of day
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', y='amount', hue='transaction_type',
                s=100, ax=axes[1, 1], palette='Set1')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Transaction Type')

# 6. Summary statistics table
axes[1, 2].axis('off')
summary_stats = df.describe()
table_data = [
    ['Total Transactions', len(df)],
    ['Total Amount', f'${df["amount"].sum():.2f}'],
    ['Average Amount', f'${df["amount"].mean():.2f}'],
    ['Min Amount', f'${df["amount"].min():.2f}'],
    ['Max Amount', f'${df["amount"].max():.2f}'],
    ['Fraud Cases', df['is_fraud'].sum()],
    ['Fraud Rate', f'{df["is_fraud"].mean()*100:.1f}%']
]

table = axes[1, 2].table(cellText=table_data,
                         cellLoc='left',
                         colWidths=[0.5, 0.3],
                         loc='center')
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(10)
table.scale(1, 2)
axes[1, 2].set_title('Summary Statistics', pad=20)

plt.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
